purpose: Determine on spent RX J2129 raw images whether the P0643 activation can generate useful absolute deflection and topology beyond a radial parent that already refits ellipticity and external shear.

candidate.component_fraction_provenance: fixed cluster baryon fractions, not fit to lens images
candidate.lambda_sign: nonnegative because the tensor correction must remain positive semidefinite

selection.screen_geometry: frozen 16-start P0601 P0599 geometry including ordinary ellipticity and external shear
selection.screen_metric: exact root RMS on training only
selection.eligibility: all 15 training roots and finite RMS

claim_boundary: Every RX J2129 image is spent; this can reject or tune a mechanism but cannot validate it.
The HST and X-ray maps set geometry using fixed 10/90 stellar/gas mass fractions; they are not independent absolute mass maps for this cluster.
The scalar parent is P0599, not a covariant relativistic theory.
A useful lambda must transfer unchanged to other spent systems and then be frozen before P0640 unsealing.
The baseline already refits external shear; an improvement is therefore not obtained by withholding ordinary shear from the control.
